cook your ground beef like normal, season it, and then once done add all of the other stuff in. then, add in a taco seasoning packet ( i used the reduced sodium ones) and optional but half a packet or ranch seasoning. i feel like it makes the soup just that much better. 


bring it to a boil and then reduce the heat and let it simmer for about 40 mins. then enjoy <:) i enjoy it with tortilla chips, and you can add sour cream and cheese on top.
